name: Village Head
tagline: The Keeper of a Thirty-Year Dream
public_profile: The respected elder who protects the village's traditions.
private_background: Thirty years ago you saw Nian beside a mountain stream. You have kept the sight and your changed meaning of the firecrackers secret.
goals: Decide whether to reveal what you saw thirty years ago
secrets: You saw Nian and were not attacked
Your firecrackers were meant as a greeting, not an attack
story: You saw a calm guardian in the mountain mist thirty years ago. Fear made you stay silent, and the village continued to misunderstand Nian.
initial_information: The letter made you lose your composure
The old firecracker tradition may have been misunderstood

relationships.description: He was with you on the mountain thirty years ago.

timeline.description: The village head and the old hunter saw Nian beside the mountain stream, but fear changed the story that was told afterward.
The firecracker maker found a cold luminous scale in a mountain crevice and sold it to the travelling merchant.
The hunter recorded falling water and strange winds while the village continued to use firecrackers as if Nian were an enemy.
A messenger left a letter asking whether the village still remembered Nian and warning that an answer was due before sunset.
The villagers must decide whether to return the scale and face the truth behind the old legend.

name: Young Scout
tagline: The Child Who Read the Hidden Message

private_background: You found the cloth strip left by the messenger and kept the writing on the back of the letter private.

Help the village hear the letter correctly

The letter has a hidden sentence on its back
story: You saw that the messenger did not come to attack. You kept two small pieces of evidence in your sleeve.
initial_information: The messenger avoided the village instead of entering it
